extension.summary: Forces software decoding for video that hardware decoding gets wrong - by path, by series or on demand - then restores hardware decoding.
extension.description:
CoreELEC's amcodec hardware decoder mishandles some videos: rotated phone/camera clips usually play stretched, some old MJPEG AVI clips won't play at all, and some 50 fps video drops frames.
Limp forces software decoding just for the videos that need it, then restores hardware decoding. Apply it to files under paths you choose (or everywhere), to TV series you pick, or to any single video from the context menu.
extension.news: v1.2.0 - Add "Limp: software decode series" and "Limp: stop software decoding series" context menu items, to always use software decoding for a TV series (e.g. 50 fps shows that drop frames) - manage the list in settings - Add start-up and periodic checks that hardware decoding is restored, e.g. after a Kodi crash or profile switch - Split the settings into General and By Path pages
